heard: The land of Seir held the old ways The hurrah chiefs kept the mountain days Loden and Shobo stood the test Zebeon and I were the best Dishon and Ezra lived in the land Dishon was the last of the band These were the sons of Seir The hoard and the place that they called their side Him down at Ashpond stood tall Ithron and Charon heard the call Sons of Dishon and the genealogy Names written in the history Before the Aesites took the land They walked across the sea of land The descendants of Esau came near They drove the old clan
